Bytes and SHA-256 are verified after restoration. Unchanged files need not be rewritten. All snapshot restorations are attempted and failures are reported instead of discarded.

validationAttemptNotes: The required full core/migration suite invokes ProjectMemory::validateColdStart on the live repository through ProcessNamespaceMigrationTests.cpp MIG-018 and FoundationNamespaceTests.cpp FOUND-019. Its canonical producer refreshed cold-start-validation.json checkedAt from 2026-09-27T09:18:22Z to 2026-09-27T10:24:57Z. Exact parsed comparison found checkedAt as the only changed field; the binding, checks and historical memory did not change. Earlier and later current results are retained in current-readonly-validation.json, final-readonly-validation.json and current-after-ctest.json. The implementation postflight recognized this as a valid canonical service change. The already-dirty live cold-start file is not included in the implementation/evidence commits, avoiding absorption of pre-existing recovery changes. No manual cold-start edit or unnecessary separate regeneration was performed.

The initial clean configure/build used build/rollback-clean-20260927. CTest from that nested directory exposed existing runner-location assumptions: CertificationFreshnessTests.cpp derives the repository only from a working directory named build, while CertificationRevalidationTests.cpp and test_update/runner/main.cpp use the executable's parent directory. The resulting freshness, revalidation and seven UPDATE fixture failures are preserved in full-ctest.json. No source/test assertion was changed. clean-runtime-staging.json proves all 20 clean-built executables were staged byte-identically into the canonical build directory, previous executables were backed up, and all 18 runtime DLLs matched. canonical-path-regression.json then records 3/3 PASS for precisely those three tests, including UPDATE 310/310. full-ctest-canonical.json is the full-suite retry under the unchanged canonical CTest definitions.

campaign-550.json preserves a failed launcher attempt with QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen: only the Windows Qt platform plugin is installed. No scenario ran in that attempt. campaign-550-windows.json is the separately recorded retry using QT_QPA_PLATFORM=windows; no product or test semantics were changed.
An incremental relink failed with Permission denied while another test was using aramf_core_tests.exe. After that process exited, incremental-relink.json records PASS. No source workaround was made.

The first full-build launcher used a nonexistent C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/cmake.exe and could not start. The actual CMake executable is C:/Program Files/CMake/bin/cmake.exe; the recorded clean-full-build command uses PATH resolution.
The evidence helper itself also could not be relinked while executing a build. A separately named helper executable was linked without modifying the running process or product implementation.
